description:
The dominator of the North who returned after conquering the war, Fernan Kaisar. 

A man perfect in every way, and the only person who remained a good memory in Yulia’s unhappy childhood. When she heard that he would become her husband, Yulia believed in the existence of God for the first time. 

However... 

"Do as you wish if there’s something you want. Whether it’s remodeling the castle, buying jewels, or throwing parties, I don’t care. Just spare me scenes like this. I don’t want to run into you in the morning."
